newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem wants powerboat champion Scioli in Congress.
newsitem.headline: Menem wants powerboat champion Scioli in Congress.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem said on Monday he was proposing world powerboat champion Daniel Scioli to stand for Congress for the ruling Peronist Party in mid-term elections in October.
Menem described Scioli as "a sportsman who has triumphed at home and abroad and made the Argentine flag fly proudly."
The 39-year-old Argentine has won six world titles in 11 years' racing, despite having to compete with one false arm since 1989, when he lost his right arm in a race.
Menem said the party was free to accept or not his choice to head the list of candidates for the Chamber of Deputies for Buenos Aires.
